messages.content: Help me execute the step method to update the graphics of an intro animation with a width of 800 pixels and a height of 600 pixels?

function.name: Intro_step
function.description: Updates the graphics of an intro animation based on the specified width and height. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

w.description: The width of the area to update. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

h.description: The height of the area to update. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.
